artifacts.summary: Phase 6: closed ChainCtx.deriv_reflect and dwitness_mem_of_maximal's diamond old-label sub-case. Relocated substFn/NIK.relabelFresh earlier in the file (content unchanged) so both use sites can reach them before FloSeq/FLO are defined. Added two new graph-generic corollaries built directly from NIK.relabelFresh -- NIK.oldLabelTransport and NIK.diaWitnessTransportOld -- needing no FloSeq/FLO at all (only source-witness freshness, never target freshness). Added GChain (a graph-only chain abstraction, dropping Context's dwitnessMem/coinfinite obligations which NIK never reads) and NIK.reflectChain (a master structural-induction reflection theorem: reflects an arbitrary NIK-derivation over a chain's union graph down to a single member, picking one fresh witness per (BoxI)/(DiaE) node and rebuilding the whole cofinite family via the one-directional transport) to close deriv_reflect, which had no prior proof skeleton. Closed dwitness_mem_of_maximal via NIK.diaWitnessTransportOld applied directly to H.G. Added a new explicit hypothesis hx0 : x0 in G0.G.X to dwitness_mem_of_maximal/diamond_of_maximal/primeLemma (a standard well-formedness assumption, matching Simpson's own implicit convention that the excluded judgement's label is a label of the graph) to rule out the one genuinely new edge case the transport surfaces (excluded label coinciding with the freshly-adjoined witness). Added Label.ne_dwitness_self (structural non-self-reference) as a small supporting lemma.
Phase 6 implementation summary, including the headline finding that primeLemma never depended on the FLO/FloSeq reconstruction at all, and the Plan Deviations section.
